regime_context: The China A-shares tape shows a narrow, two-theme leadership structure: Banks (rank 1, score 0.998, eligible, crowded) and Innovative Pharma & CXO (rank 2, score 0.988, eligible, crowded) dominate, while rotation breadth is only 18% and one-narrative flag is false. Critically, the absolute-trend gate did NOT hold on this market's history (gate_helps=false) and the track record's directional accuracy is weak (dir_accuracy 0.377 over n=77), so all leans below are deliberately low-conviction.
emerging_watch: Watch whether Semiconductors (cn_semis, rank 8, score 0.315, eligible=true, durability_bar 0.54, breadth 0.091) can broaden its participation — currently eligible but extremely narrow. The observable condition that would retire this watch: Semiconductors' breadth rises above 0.4 while maintaining eligibility for 10 consecutive trading days, or its eligibility flips false for 10 consecutive trading days.

theses.subject: Banks
theses.thesis: Banks are the sole eligible and highest-score theme with broad internal breadth (0.889) and the highest durability_bar (0.73), suggesting the leadership is genuine and not a one-stock artifact. The trend-gate leg is the only validated discipline and it flags Banks as eligible; durability is high. However, crowding_z of 1.78 means this is a size-down caution only, not a reason to avoid. Given gate_helps=false on this market, the lean is held with low conviction.
evidence: rotation.leader is Banks with margin 0.01 over challenger
theses.dissent: Banks are heavily crowded (crowded=true, crowding_z 1.78) and the absolute-trend gate has no drawdown-reduction edge on this mean-reverting China A-shares history, so eligibility may whipsaw; the momentum rank itself has no forward return predictive power (rank-IC ~0).

falsifier.text: Banks (512800.SS) underperform the CSI 300 by 5% or lose its rank-1 eligibility within 20 trading days

theses.subject: Innovative Pharma & CXO
theses.thesis: Pharma & CXO is the close challenger (score 0.988 vs 0.998, margin 0.01) and is also eligible with a solid durability_bar of 0.60, making it the only other theme with trend-gate approval. Breadth of 0.643 is moderate. Crowding_z 1.59 flags as a sizing caution, not a fade. The rotation radar is not directional, so this is a co-leader lean, not a handoff call.
theses.dissent: The theme is heavily crowded (crowded=true) and breadth is only moderate; if the narrow two-theme regime breaks, a crowded challenger that never takes rank-1 may fall harder than the broader leader.

falsifier.text: Innovative Pharma & CXO (159992.SZ) underperforms the CSI 300 by 5% or loses eligibility within 20 trading days

theses.subject: AI Compute & Optics
theses.thesis: AI Compute & Optics ranks 3rd but is ineligible (eligible=false) with a very weak durability_bar of 0.28 and near-zero breadth (0.059), indicating the theme is not trending or broadly shared. The trend-gate leg has not blessed it, and on this market the gate does not even help drawdown control, so an ineligible theme with weak breadth deserves avoidance rather than a contrarian lean.
theses.dissent: hurst_tag is 'trend' and the theme is not crowded (crowding_z -0.66), which could mean early-stage accumulation before breadth builds; avoiding may lock out a future leader if breadth improves.

falsifier.text: AI Compute & Optics (515000.SS) becomes eligible and its breadth rises above 0.5 within 20 trading days
